recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a bearded man in a denim shirt and trucker hat, set against a blurred industrial or rural background, featuring heavy, weathered display typography at the top and a secondary italicized subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally with a slight profile turn to the left.
Typography anchored to the top edge, spanning the width of the frame.
Contrast between the sharp, detailed subject and the soft, bokeh-heavy background.
Textural harmony between the weathered font and the denim fabric.
coreInvariants: Weathered or distressed texture on primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, waist-up, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the primary display text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top text, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the line of the denim shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper third to accommodate large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blues from the denim shirt and trucker hat.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Neutral grays and browns in the blurred background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep navy and weathered steel-gray in the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high tonal range in the subject's clothing and facial features.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones and indigo shades

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, blocky sans-serif with industrial proportions.
letterConstructionRules: Internal distressing and texture resembling rusted metal or worn stone
characterSpecificRedesigns: Small triangular notches or spurs on the midpoints of vertical strokes
Open counters in letters like 'R' and 'G'
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy weathered display font paired with a clean, slanted secondary sans-serif for contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy, blocky industrial feel required for the display text.
Captures the weathered, rustic texture and spurs.
Suitable for the clean, slanted subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution portrait of a man with a beard wearing a light blue denim shirt and a navy trucker hat. He is looking off-camera to the left. The background is a blurred outdoor scene with industrial elements like train tracks or wooden beams under an overcast sky. Leave the top 30% of the image as clear negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, wide-tracked uppercase display title in a weathered steel-gray color at the top. Below it, right-aligned to the end of the title, add a smaller subtitle in a navy blue, slanted sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text weathered and textured?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to create depth?
Is the subject's denim shirt texture visible?
Is the subtitle italicized and right-aligned?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the weathered texture on text
Tracking width of the display text
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent lighting on the subject and text.
Ensure the text distressing doesn't compromise legibility.
Verify the horizontal centering of the subject.
Confirm the color palette remains within muted blue and gray tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rugged, medium-shot outdoor portrait with a high-contrast, weathered industrial display font anchored at the top of the frame.
